name: Prithviraj
player_statement:
A complete player, Prithviraj has made a big mark in cricket. With 3 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 17*, with an average of 19.00 and a quick strike rate of 211.11. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 2 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 11.0 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 5.00. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
